notes.title: Blasting new boss and more!
notes.content:
[h1]New Veg out Crew FPS Update![/h1]

[h2][b]YeYa[/b][/h2]

We have a heap of new content that has just landed!

[h2]Firstly[/h2]
A new boss! We'll keep him quiet but you'll get to vs him on the last stage, stage 6!
Yes, that's right, a whole new stage too! 5 levels of the stage and it's a rad one too!
With this there are also new enemies, cucumber big and small, and other crazy enemies too!!
Also, we have added some alt fire attacks to most weapons and fine tuned them too! Keep your eye out for these.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/5f25dbb2b3551d10006d64bc8b228dd2172ba3c4.png[/img]

There's also a few power ups on the boss stages and a heap of content adjustments too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/90f31045dd62aa81f638d9e2fe0a53e98c588858.png[/img]

So what are you waiting for? Go on in and get veg out blasting!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/beb9be7bbd110c9b6d4a4e4c5220212afceddf9c.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New boss
[*] New stage
[*] New enemies
[*] Updated weapons
[*] And heaps more fun
[/list]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/7353d426d8d1c77ff96613325258c677125232ed.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update - more bosses, more levels, weapons and more!
notes.content:
[h3][b]New Update for Veg out Crew - THE FPS![/b][/h3]

We've got new [h2]bosses[/h2]!!

[list]
[*] Banana Boss
[*] Potato Boss
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/76f21ca8f629649d75304da6eff907e421df1fc1.png[/img]

[h2]A heap more levels![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/41115b2e37a704614658577281cc0b2cd4befb62.png[/img]

A few more [h2]weapons [/h2]including:

[list]
[*] Strawberry Press
[*] Banana Peeler
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/332583fdd2539962ec12d50b0a6a943fb1a76eb3.png[/img]

Also added a super simple Save and Load feature based on your profile!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42664100/62dc46bafb7862a8a03799c9754f5115653dfebf.png[/img]

Yes, we've got some character heads happening now for the character you choose!

And a fair bit more...

So don't wait, get in and start your journey!
